# color-token-ref-in-sync

Fails if `plugins/ui/plugins/tokens/plugins/color-ref/core/color-token-ref.generated.ts`
(the `ColorTokenRef` union) drifts from the vars the palette token groups
declare (`COLOR_TOKEN_REF_GROUPS`, read from their real descriptors). Fix by
running `./equin build` (or `./equin regen-generated`) and committing the
regenerated file.
